name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_clear_status_list
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::ClearStatusList clears the status list box contents and resets the tracked status line count.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43ebd0 validates SendMessageA on m_statusList.m_hWnd with LB_RESETCONTENT, wParam 0, lParam 0, followed by m_statusLineCount = 0.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_clear_status_list_smoke creates a real listbox, preloads two rows and a nonzero line count, calls ClearStatusList, and verifies both the listbox count and m_statusLineCount are reset to zero.
